versions.subject: Merge PR #4950 from @nasbench - Comply With v2 Spec Changes
Merge PR #5639 from @swachchhanda000 - Fix some more fps found in prod
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\sc.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'create'
        - 'binPath'
filter_optional_dropbox:
    ParentImage|startswith:
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Dropbox\Client\'
        - 'C:\Program Files\Dropbox\Client\'
    ParentImage|endswith: '\Dropbox.exe'
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_optional_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\sc.exe" CommandLine="*create*" CommandLine="*binPath*" NOT (ParentImage IN ("C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Dropbox\\Client\\*", "C:\\Program Files\\Dropbox\\Client\\*") ParentImage="*\\Dropbox.exe")
